items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think this is what leads to “Star Time”—comedians Jerry Lester, Lou Holtz.

ctx.x: Yes, and Benny Fields and Blossom singing. I was in a show called “Star Time.”
I think this is what leads to “Star Time”—comedians Jerry Lester, Lou Holtz. Tell me about Lou Holtz and how he came into your career.

He showed me how to walk out on a stage, Lou Holtz did. And I think he owned a piece of the San Francisco Hotel. But he showed me how to walk out. And he said, “If you give love in your eyes, then you’ll get love in response back.” And I was in the show with him, the Berry brothers got sick so I took their place. They were working too hard, like Buddy Collette, you know.
